column1: （注1）第26回（2006年6月）は、訪問留置法での調査のほか、予備調査として郵送調査も実施。
（注2）極端な値を排除するために上下各々0.5％のサンプルを除いて計算した値。
（注3）回答を数値順に並べた際に中央に位置する値。
（注4）地価見通しD.I.＝「上がる」－「下がる」。
（注5）経済成長力D.I.＝「より高い成長が見込める」－「より低い成長しか見込めない」。
（注6）5年後の暮らし向きD.I.＝「良くなる」－「悪くなる」。
（注7）勤労者：会社員・公務員（会社役員を含む）およびパート・アルバイトなど （第31回<2007年9月>までは「勤労者：会社員・公務員・その他雇用者、パート・アルバイト」）。
(Note 1) Calculated by excluding 0.5 percent of the highest and lowest figures, respectively, in order to avoid extremes.
(Note 2) The number that appears in the middle when the answers are listed in numerical order.
(Note 3) The land prices D.I. is calculated as the proportion of respondents who answered that land prices "will go up" minus the proportion of those who answered that they "will go down."

(Note 4) The Japanese economy's growth potential D.I. is calculated as the proportion of respondents who answered that the Japanese economy "has greater potential to grow compared to the current level of growth" minus the proportion of those who answered that it "has less potential to grow compared to the current level of growth."

(Note 5) The household circumstances D.I. for the outlook for over the next five years is calculated as the proportion of respondents who answered that their household circumstances "will improve" minus the proportion of those who answered that they "will worsen."

(Note 6) Workers are company employees, executives, civil servants, and part-timers. Up until the 31st survey (September 2007), they were referred to as company employees, civil servants, other types of employees, or part-timers.
